verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud is documented as 'Multi-Cloud & Multi-Region' in pricing tiers, implying some geographic placement control, and self-hosting lets users pick any region entirely themselves. However there's no explicit documentation of data-residency guarantees, region selection UI/API, or compliance-driven residency controls for AI-native workloads. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection controls in Temporal Cloud, documentation on where workflow/event history data is stored and how to restrict it, data-residency compliance guarantees (e.g., EU data boundary), independent confirmation of residency enforcement.
